projects.notes: WSDOT capital Project Delivery Plan (state highway/ferry projects), polylines. No status/phase field: milestone dates instead (ProjDef, BeginPE, EnvirDoc, RWCert = right-of-way certification, AdDate = advertisement, OperComplete = operationally complete), all epoch ms. Planned = AdDate in the future (334 records on 2026-11-16) or OperComplete in the future; RWCert in the future flags pending right-of-way. WorkDescription is a short work label; ProgramDesc/SubCategoryDesc are coarser groupings. Newest LastUpdated value is Nov 2024, so check freshness. Same service also at .../FeatureServer/0. Older yearly plans are in Shared/WSDOTProjectData/MapServer.

parcels_statewide_note: null for owners: Washington's statewide Current Parcels (https://services.arcgis.com/jsIt88o09Q0r1j8h/arcgis/rest/services/Current_Parcels/FeatureServer/0, 3.3M records, verified) has parcel id, situs address, land use and land/building value but NO owner name. Washington law (RCW 42.56.070(8)) bars agencies from providing lists of individuals for commercial purposes, which is why most counties leave names out.

parcels_counties.restrictions: None seen on the layer; RCW 42.56.070(8) restricts use of public-record lists of individuals for commercial purposes.
parcels_counties.notes: Third-party city copy of Clark County assessor taxlots EXCLUDING parcels inside Battle Ground city limits; PublishDt 2026 in the sample. Clark County's own 'Taxlots for Public Use' layer carries only MainOwnerID, not names. OwnAddrs is a concatenated owner address.

summary: WSDOT Project Delivery Plan line layer verified (1,582 projects, cost, ad date, RW certification date). Parcels: statewide layer has no owner names; only a city-hosted copy of Clark County taxlots with owners was verified. King and Pierce county layers checked have no owner name (Pierce has mailing address only); Snohomish and Spokane not found.
